name: todo_add
description: Add a todo. With "room": adds to that chatroom's shared todo list, visible to every clanker subscribed to the room (it rides the chatroom log and peer fan-out); share the returned id or use todo_list so others can claim or close it. Without "room" (sub-agent runs only): adds to your private run-scoped list, which is discarded when you return — its final state is appended to your answer so your caller sees your progress.

room.description: Room name for the shared list, e.g. "dev". Omit it inside a sub-agent run to use your private list.

title.description: Short description of the task (max 512 chars)
